articles.title: Polymarket expands AI compute markets as US rivals face delays
articles.summary: Polymarket is launching prediction markets for AI compute pricing and availability, betting that traders want to speculate on GPU scarcity and cloud infrastructure costs while US competitors drag their feet. This matters because compute costs directly drive AI company valuations and capex spending, so markets that price these inputs give traders a real edge on predicting everything from Nvidia's earnings to which labs actually have the juice to train frontier models.

articles.title: Where Every League Stands on Kalshi, Polymarket
articles.summary: Sports leagues are finally taking public stances on whether they'll allow Kalshi and Polymarket to operate prediction markets on their games. If major leagues crack down, it chops off a significant revenue stream and user base for platforms that have built their entire pitch around real-money sports betting.

articles.title: Crypto.com’s Prediction Market Spinoff Feels Liquidity Crunch
articles.summary: Crypto.com spun off its prediction market platform and is now getting absolutely starved for liquidity, which is basically death for a betting venue where nobody wants to trade. When your order book is thinner than a startup's runway, you're watching the prediction market equivalent of a ghost town, and that's exactly what happens when volume dries up.

articles.title: Prediction markets push OpenAI IPO expectations later into 2027
articles.summary: OpenAI is now expected to go public sometime later in 2027 instead of earlier in the year, according to prediction market data. If true, it delays when early bettors can cash out their positions and shifts the timeline for one of tech's most anticipated IPOs by several months.

articles.title: Gold drops below $3,500; prediction markets price moderate year-end targets
articles.summary: Gold's plunge below $3,500 is forcing traders to recalibrate their expectations for where the precious metal finishes 2024. The disconnect between spot price and year-end predictions signals either that markets think gold bounces back hard or that the consensus has gotten too bearish too fast, creating real arbitrage opportunities for those willing to take a contrarian stance.

articles.title: Van Hollen Calls Senate Democratic Leader Race 'Wide Open' as Prediction Markets Favor Schumer
articles.summary: Senate Democrats are picking their next leader, and Van Hollen says it's anyone's game despite prediction markets heavily favoring Schumer to keep the role. The gap between political rhetoric and market odds creates an arbitrage opportunity if Van Hollen knows something the smart money doesn't.

articles.title: Los Angeles Lakers Announce Partnership with Kalshi
articles.summary: The Lakers just inked a deal with Kalshi, the CFTC-regulated prediction market platform, likely for sponsorship or official betting integration. This matters because it signals major sports leagues are finally comfortable going all-in on prediction markets instead of just tolerating them from the sidelines.

articles.title: Kalshi daily volume of ‘perps’ trading begins to top its prediction markets
articles.summary: Kalshi's perpetual futures contracts are now trading more volume than its core prediction market offerings, signaling a shift in what customers actually want from the platform. If derivatives outpace event betting long term, it suggests the real money is in leveraged speculation rather than forecasting accuracy.

articles.title: Utah drops criminal charges against Kalshi founders after company suspended operations in state
articles.summary: Utah's crackdown on Kalshi, the prediction markets platform, is officially dead after the state dropped criminal charges against the company's founders now that Kalshi pulled out of the state. This matters because it signals regulatory bodies will back off if you simply leave, which could embolden other prediction market platforms to operate selectively rather than fight legal battles.

articles.title: Kalshi Users Under 21 Lost $8.9 Million in NYC, Probe Finds
articles.summary: Regulators found that Kalshi's underage users in New York City lost $8.9 million, raising questions about the platform's age verification and risk controls. It's the kind of regulatory hammer that could force prediction market operators to overhaul their compliance infrastructure or face actual restrictions instead of the current wink-and-nod regulatory environment.

articles.title: Young New Yorkers Are Losing on Kalshi, City Council Says
articles.summary: New York City Council is claiming young residents are getting cleaned out on Kalshi, the prediction market platform that's been operating legally in the city since 2023. If regulators start clamping down on retail participation or user protections, it could signal the beginning of the end for prediction markets' mainstream credibility just as they're finally going legit.

articles.title: Capitol Hill trading is about to be verboten, House Democrats say as they debate how
articles.summary: House Democrats are pushing to ban members of Congress from trading individual stocks, closing a loophole that's let them profit off non-public information for decades. If it passes, it removes a reliable signal that political insiders once used to telegraph their conviction on upcoming policy moves.
